title: Fundraiser for Ukraine • Pop-Up Sale and Concert | Diving Bell
descriptionHtml:
We’ve teamed up with Sasha Cay to organize a fundraiser for Ukraine featuring a number of local vendors and musicians. We will also have a raffle draw featuring some amazing prizes from local shops/musicians/artisans!

____________________________________________________________________________________________________________

19h00 – 21h00: Pop-up shop with snacks and tunes!
• Trap Door Printing
• Luddite Candles
• Soie Lait
• Jade Simard / Textile Hustler
• Café Bandit
• Big M Thrift
• Evangelos James Photo
• Robin BB Art
• Maison Lou’s CZA
• Vale

____________________________________________________________________________________________________________

21h00 – 21h30: Raffle! Prizes From:
Solidgoldfx Pedals • Dispatch Coffee • Robin BB Tattoo • Pizza Bouquet • John Climenhage Painting • Jade Simard/Textile Hustler • Encore Books & Records • Arbutus Records • Michele.Ange Tattoos • Soie Lait Jewelry • Amery Press • Local Band Tees

____________________________________________________________________________________________________________

21h30 – 23h30: Performances!
• Ahren Strange
• Georgie
• Let’s Be Giants
• Still Kicking

____________________________________________________________________________________________________________

23h30 – 1h30: Karaoke!

____________________________________________________________________________________________________________

Tickets –
• Admittance to the pop-up/show BEFORE 20h00 will be $7
•After 20h00 will be $15 AND include one raffle ticket
• Additional raffle tickets will cost $3 each

____________________________________________________________________________________________________________

Where are we giving this money??
Funds from the ticket sales, raffle ticket sales and a percentage of the vendor profits will be donated to two organizations:

UCC Montreal – The Ukrainian Canadian Congress Montreal branch has been working with the Canada Ukraine Foundation to provide both monetary support, supplies and evacuation coordination over the course of the last few weeks. It feels important to work with an organization with local roots given the robust Ukrainian population present in our own city.
https://uccmontreal.ca/

____________________________________________________________________________________________________________

CARE Organization – We have also been impressed with the transparency and great detail CARE has provided in terms of of it’s relief/aid efforts in Ukraine over the last few weeks. We are happy to send CARE half of our funds in order to help their effort to provide Ukrainians with food and water supplies, as well as hygiene kits, cash assistance and psychosocial support.
https://www.care.org/…/eme…/ukraine-humanitarian-crisis/

descriptionHtml:

Alan Mackie and Jaron Freeman-Fox are Porch Couch, reanimating old-time and square dance tunes from Appalachia and beyond on fiddle and banjo, deftly balancing a deep respect for tradition against all the times they’ve shirked it: throat singing with Norwegians in a Siberian yurt camp, modern dancers leaping across tables at the PWYC bar gig, or playing for ravers under the midnight sun and somebody’s banging pool cues on the floor. title: Nyssa + Christina Bell + Fiscall Harm (UK) | L’Esco
descriptionHtml:
KickDrum presents:
—

Nyssa – Toronto pagan-punk-poet NYSSA has put her hands into the lion’s mouth, gathering her performing and songwriting powers to conjure the unruly energy of rock n’ roll. Out from under fear’s thumb, NYSSA now sings about wild things, old gods, romance-beyond-borders, and the exorcism of trauma. She has quested, and she has returned.

The goal is fevered connection, a ritual-sense of music as communal release. NYSSA keens and wails and brings her audience along with her to a place of deep feeling, movement, and joy. Her lyrics are poetic and clear, lunar, eerie, angry; NYSSA’s voice is the strong container for all of it. As Dionysus would want it, over-abundance is the way. Guided by the incantation and invocation of the three C’s: Collaboration, Choreo, Covenhood!, NYSSA’s sound and stories run deep into ancient mythos, Celtic lore and back through our modern idols. Re-swaggering, re-wilding hyper-masc night moves and magick hips (think Jagger, Mink Deville, Danzig), NYSSA’s magnetic, elastic ways make satyrs of us all.

NYSSA was once again nominated for the Polaris Music Prize long list with her sophomore album, Shake Me Where I’m Foolish, released on Six Shooter Records on February 1, 2024.
